integrity: The dyadic-gap lemma and rank optimization were reconstructed symbolically. Exact-arithmetic checks replay finite sanity tests; they are not used as a substitute for the infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The theorem is specific to supports \(\{2,p\}\); it does not classify equality for general \(p\) or settle the analogous \(\{p,q\}\) question for two odd primes.
title: A binary-gap rank bound for two-prime Egyptian fractions
